name: Greek Dressing
siboNotes: Contains garlic and onion which can trigger SIBO symptoms. Use sparingly and consider garlic-infused oil versions for better tolerance.
preparationTips: Make homemade version using garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Use dried oregano and basil for authentic Greek flavor without FODMAPs
Add lemon juice and red wine vinegar for tang without high FODMAP ingredients
Store in refrigerator and shake well before each use
alternatives: Simple lemon and olive oil dressing
